Must-see Home For Sale In Copperas Cove! #realestate 

There is a reason Cove is the nickname for Copperas Cove. This charming three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath home offers a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

The expansive lot, beautifully landscaped, provides ample space for both family members and fur babies to play. The backyard features a playscape that will remain with the house, while the inviting front porch is perfect for relaxing and visiting with neighbors. The patio is ready for summer barbecues or early morning coffees.

As you enter the home, you’re greeted by a spacious dining area on your right, ideal for dinners with family and friends. The kitchen, a cook’s delight, is well-appointed and adjacent to a large utility room, providing plenty of space for pantry items and kitchen gadgets. The extra-large washer and dryer fit snugly here, and a cozy breakfast nook is perfect for quick meals.

The living area is expansive, ready to accommodate a large sectional for your TV binge-watching sessions. A convenient half bath on the main floor is perfect for guests.

Upstairs, you'll find your true sanctuary. The additional bedrooms and second bath offer just the right amount of space for individual needs. The master suite is a haven of relaxation, spacious enough for a king-size bed and additional large furniture. The master bath features a luxurious soaking tub and a separate shower, providing a perfect escape from the outside world.
